_about: Walo app settings. Place-, crop- or service-specific settings that are not NASA, price or crop data live here, so the code has no fixed place, market or crop names.

zones._source: FAO Ghana agro-ecological zones (crop calendar region text)

farm._note: default (Walo wording choice, no standard): within this many days of the estimated harvest the field says 'Harvest soon'.

photos._note: Photos used as labels on cards and photo bands (credits in data/credits.json).

backup._note: Optional sign-in to back up fields (Supabase project 'walo'). Only the publishable key is here; it is safe in a browser because every table and photo is locked to its owner by row-level security.
backup._note_settings: settings_id: the one row per person (same table) that keeps the main crop choice; it is not a field.

photo._note: One photo path (js/photo.js): the camera and gallery inputs sit in index.html and are opened by <label for>, never by script. Photos are copied into memory at once, shrunk to this size, and if the browser cannot open one, Plant Doctor may send the original when it is small enough.

log._note: Client log for real-phone problems (js/log.js -> api/log.js): event names, counts, sizes and types only; no photos, words or places.

crop_groups._note: Crop lists for a place are grouped by when you can plant (js/data.js cropGroups, from the same onset/FAO-56/forecast rules as Plant now). 'soon' = the next planting month is within soon_months; 'no' = outside the crop's FAO zones, no planting month here, or FAO class below 'can grow' (score below min_score).

groups.title: Plant now if you can water

twi._note: Twi by GhanaNLP Khaya through /api/twi (machine translation and voice; needs a Twi speaker's check). Fixed labels: data/i18n-tw.json, built once by scripts/build_i18n_tw.py.

support._note: Get help: the AI helper (/api/help) answers first; 'Talk to a person' shows Call and WhatsApp to this number. Empty phone = the person option is hidden and the app says the help line is coming soon. International format without +, e.g. 233XXXXXXXXX.

offline._note: What still works without internet (said in the Needs internet sheet).
